note: The March 1906 map is the nearer one before the 1910 census. The February 1912 map is used where it shows a later name or a plant the 1906 sheet does not, and those lines say 1912.

update.name: Jewelry & Photo
update.notes: Hurst corner room, March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 72. The sheet labels jewelry and photographs. The pediment and finial remain on this corner.

update.name: Dry Goods
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 72, the next room west of the jewelry and photo room, labeled dry goods.

update.name: Bowling
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 72. This room of the brick block is labeled bowling.

update.name: Restaurant
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 72, labeled Rest.

update.name: Saloon
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 72, labeled Sal. A gambling room is marked on the second floor of this part of the block.

update.name: Harness
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 72. The harness shop is drawn in brick, two stories, with a birds room beside it. In 1893 and 1898 this shop was frame.

update.name: Bushnell Electric Light & Power Co.
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 2, and the February 1912 sheet, label the Bushnell Electric Light & Power Co. beside the pump works. The 1893 name on this plant was Vanderveer & Logsdon.

update.name: Bushnell Tank & Fence Works
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 2, the large brick plant west of the tracks labeled Bushnell Tank & Fence Works. The February 1912 sheet calls it Bushnell Tank Works. The 1893 sheet labeled a brick plant in this district N.E.F. Manufacturing Co.

update.name: J. C. Simpson & Co.
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, lumber sheds along the railroad labeled J. C. Simpson & Co. The 1893 name on this yard was Mack & M. Pinckley.

update.name: J. W. Roach Livery
update.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 81, labels J. W. Roach Livery. The 1885 history names John Roach's livery. The barn stays on the west side near Barnes.

March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 5, block 73, the Hurst side of the block between Barnes and Hurst, south of Crawford. The sheet labels M. E. Church, brick, with a spire. The February 1912 sheet of the Hail block south of Crawford shows dwellings there, not this church.

The German Methodist church, built in 1857 at West Hail and Jackson, is still drawn on February 1912 Sanborn sheet 5, block 62, the Hail end of the Jackson side. The sheet labels it German M.E. Church and marks it vacant. The building stays.

add.name: Martin Schulze
add.notes: February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 2, labels Martin Schulze Poultry and Ice House near East Main and East Davis. The March 1906 sheet of this ground was not given this name. The lot is that works block, not a storefront measurement.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: A frame house on the east side of Charles Street. The March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 2, shows dwellings beside the pump-works block. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: A frame house on Charles Street. March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 2. No family name is printed.

add.name: Lodgings
add.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 3, block 72, lot 2, on the Crawford side. The sheet labels a two-story lodgings and leaves the middle of the lot open. The May 1898 dwelling on this lot is taken off. The February 1912 sheet still shows dwellings on this side of the block. No family name is printed.

add.name: Jas. Cole Flats
add.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 4, block 59, lot 306, on the Crawford side toward Hail. The sheet labels Jas. Cole Flats, two stories, brick. The May 1898 sheet shows a frame dwelling on this lot and does not print this name.

add.name: F. M. Black Livery
add.notes: March 1906 Sanborn, sheet 4, block 60, behind the Campbellite Meeting House on the Dean side. Labeled F. M. Black Livery. The January 1886 sheet shows a cabinet shop on this part of the block and does not label a livery.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Two-story frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 57, about lot 9. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 6. Lot 10 on this side is empty on that sheet. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Two-story frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 57, about lot 11. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 6. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Two-story frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 57, about lot 12, the Hail end. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 6. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Two-story frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 50. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 6, the row of six dwellings between Hail and Gridley. The model already had houses on the other five of those lots. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 79, between Davis and Barnes. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 4. The Crawford side of this block already had a dwelling on each lot. Two lots on the Rile side had no house in the file. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 79, the next lot toward Barnes. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 4. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 74, the Barnes end. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 4, the row of six dwellings south of Rile between Barnes and Hurst. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 74. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 4. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 74, toward Hurst. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 4. No family name is printed.

add.name: Cottage Home
add.notes: February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 4, block 73, the Barnes end south of Crawford. The sheet labels Cottage Home and boarding. The stand-in house on that corner is taken off. No family name beyond the boarding name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Two-story frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 78, about lot 9. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 4. Lots 7 and 11 on this side have no dwelling. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Rile side of block 78, the Barnes end, about lot 12. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 4. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Two-story frame dwelling on block 83, about lot 2, the Washington side between Davis and Barnes. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 3. Lots 3, 4, and 5 on this block have no dwelling. No family name is printed. The 1886, 1893, 1898, and 1906 detail sheets do not reach this block.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Dean side of block 82, about lot 5. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 3. A dwelling is drawn on each of the six Dean lots. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Dean side of block 82, about lot 4. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 3. No family name is printed.

add.name: Dwelling
add.notes: Frame dwelling on the Dean side of block 82, the Barnes end. February 1912 Sanborn, sheet 3. No family name is printed.
